source_note: PROTOTYPE: hand-written static figures for the demo. Edit by hand; replace with CSO / Daft.ie / PPR figures before relying on them.

national.note: Prices still rising nationally, driven by limited housing supply.

interest_rates.note: Rates have eased from their 2023 peak; fixed rates are generally cheaper than variable.

Dublin.note: Strong demand; apartments rising more slowly than houses.

Cork.note: City and commuter belt rising fast.

Wicklow.note: High prices near the Dublin border.

Limerick.note: Strong growth from a lower base.

Donegal.note: Lowest prices; mica-affected properties need extra checks.

Leitrim.note: Small market; few sales, so trends are noisy.
